nodes.description: Private mapping address=>bool used as a blacklist flag in PinkPanda; read by _beforeTokenTransfer and written by BlacklistBot and the constructor.
Private address _uni set by RenounceOwnership and compared against the transfer recipient in _beforeTokenTransfer.
Private owner address of the Ownable contract, set in the constructor and read by owner().
Mapping address=>uint256 holding token balances; mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>uint256 holding allowances; written by _approve and read by transferFrom.
Total token supply, increased by _mint, decreased by _burn and read by the PinkPanda cap check.
Owner-only function that toggles the blacklist flag _enable[user] for an arbitrary address.
Owner-only function that assigns an arbitrary address to the privileged _uni state variable.
Overridden ERC20 hook that reverts the transfer when the recipient equals _uni and the sender is not enabled.
Overridden internal mint enforcing a hard cap of 1000000000e18 before calling ERC20._mint.
Mints the initial supply to a hardcoded address and enables that address in the _enable mapping.
Modifier requiring owner() == _msgSender(); guards BlacklistBot and RenounceOwnership.
View function returning the stored _owner address.
Internal helper returning msg.sender for meta-transaction compatible callers.
Internal transfer routine that validates addresses, calls the before-transfer hook and rewrites balances.
Internal routine validating owner/spender and writing the allowance mapping.
Internal mint that increases _totalSupply and the recipient balance and emits Transfer.
Internal burn that decreases the account balance and the total supply.
Public ERC20 transfer delegating to _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that transfers, checks the allowance and reduces it via _approve.
Public ERC20 approve delegating to _approve.
Atomically increases the caller's allowance for a spender via _approve.
Atomically decreases the caller's allowance for a spender via _approve.
Caller-controlled address read from msg.sender inside Context._msgSender and compared against the owner.
State write _enable[user] = enable performed by BlacklistBot, granting/revoking an address's ability to sell.
State write _uni = uni_ performed by RenounceOwnership, re-pointing the address gated by the transfer hook.
Balance mutation _balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount; _balances[recipient] += amount inside _transfer.
Supply and balance mutation _totalSupply += amount; _balances[account] += amount inside ERC20._mint.
require(_enable[from], "something went wrong") gate enforced inside _beforeTokenTransfer.
Allowance write _allowances[owner][spender] = amount inside _approve.
Address parameter user of PinkPanda.BlacklistBot used to index the _enable mapping.
Boolean parameter enable of PinkPanda.BlacklistBot stored into _enable[user].
Address parameter uni_ of PinkPanda.RenounceOwnership assigned to the _uni state variable.
From address of the overridden transfer hook, used to query the _enable blacklist.
Recipient address of the overridden transfer hook, compared against _uni.
Amount parameter of the overridden transfer hook, not used in the hook body.
Recipient account parameter of PinkPanda._mint forwarded to super._mint.
Mint amount parameter of PinkPanda._mint used in the cap check and forwarded to super._mint.
Cached _balances[sender] value used for the transfer balance arithmetic.
Cached allowance value used for the transferFrom allowance arithmetic.

edges.reason: Parameter user flows into BlacklistBot and indexes the blacklist mapping.
Parameter enable flows into BlacklistBot as the new blacklist flag value.
BlacklistBot performs the privileged blacklist state write.
The blacklist write mutates the _enable mapping.
onlyOwner modifier guards the execution of BlacklistBot.
msg.sender is read by Context._msgSender.
_msgSender result feeds the owner() access-control comparison.
owner() is compared with _msgSender() inside the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender must equal the stored owner for onlyOwner to pass.
onlyOwner modifier guards the execution of RenounceOwnership.
Parameter uni_ flows into RenounceOwnership.
RenounceOwnership assigns the privileged _uni address.
The assignment writes the _uni state variable.
Parameter from is used by the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
Parameter to is compared against _uni in the transfer hook.
The hook reads the _uni state variable to decide gating.
Parameter amount is passed to the overridden transfer hook.
The hook enforces the blacklist require statement.
from is used to index the _enable blacklist mapping inside the gate.
The blacklist gate reads the _enable state variable.
_transfer invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before balance state updates, allowing state-inconsistent reentrant behaviour.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom reduces the allowance by calling _approve.
_transfer performs the balance subtraction and addition.
The balance update writes the _balances mapping.
_approve performs the allowance state write.
The allowance write mutates _allowances.
transferFrom reads the current allowance from _allowances.
ERC20._mint performs the supply and balance increments.
The mint increments the _totalSupply state variable.
The mint increments the recipient balance in _balances.
PinkPanda._mint calls super._mint after the cap check.
Parameter account flows into the capped mint function.
Parameter amount flows into the capped mint function.
The cap check reads totalSupply before minting.
The PinkPanda constructor mints the initial supply.
Local senderBalance is used in the transfer balance arithmetic.
Local currentAllowance is used in the transferFrom allowance arithmetic.
_burn mutates the _balances mapping of the burned account.
owner() reads the _owner state variable.
increaseAllowance routes the new allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance routes the reduced allowance through _approve.
approve routes the new allowance through _approve.
transfer resolves the sender through _msgSender.
transferFrom resolves the spender through _msgSender.
approve resolves the owner through _msgSender.
The constructor performs a privileged blacklist write for the initial holder.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter user only feeds the BlacklistBot core function's blacklist write and carries no independent semantics.
Parameter enable only feeds the BlacklistBot core function's blacklist write and carries no independent semantics.
Parameter uni_ is exclusively used by RenounceOwnership to set the _uni state variable.
Parameter from is only used by the _beforeTokenTransfer hook to query the blacklist gate.
Parameter to is only used by the _beforeTokenTransfer hook to compare against _uni.
Parameter amount is passed to the _beforeTokenTransfer hook and is unused in its body.
Parameter account is only forwarded from PinkPanda._mint into the capped super._mint call.
Parameter amount is only used by PinkPanda._mint in the cap check and the super._mint call.
Local senderBalance exists solely to compute the _balances update unsafe operation in _transfer.
Local currentAllowance exists solely to compute the allowance arithmetic in transferFrom.
